name: mdhub
description: mdhub is an AI scribe built specifically for behavioral health—psychiatry, therapy, and mental health documentation. The platform powers Talkiatry (the largest in-network telepsychiatry network in the US), validating it at scale for psychiatric workflows. mdhub's AI assistant 'Emma' captures sessions in real-time, generates SOAP/DAP/BIRP/progress notes, and includes CPT coding suggestions. Key differentiator: purpose-built for psychiatry with medication management, diagnosis codes, presenting problems, and interventions captured accurately. BAA included with every subscription. Audio is processed in real-time and never stored. Pricing requires contact—not publicly listed.

faqs.a: mdhub does not publish pricing. You must contact their sales team for a quote. BAA is included with every subscription. If you need transparent pricing, consider Freed ($39-119/mo) or Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) instead.

faqs.q: What is mdhub's relationship with Talkiatry?
faqs.a: Talkiatry, the largest in-network telepsychiatry network in the US, has made mdhub available to its psychiatrists and therapists. This validates mdhub at scale for psychiatric workflows—covering both psychiatric and therapy documentation needs.

faqs.q: Is mdhub good for therapy or just psychiatry?
faqs.a: mdhub is designed for the full range of behavioral health—psychiatry and therapy. It supports SOAP, DAP, BIRP, and progress notes. However, if you specifically need modality-aware therapy notes (CBT, DBT), Mentalyc may be more specialized.
No. mdhub processes audio in real-time for transcription and note generation. Audio is never stored on mdhub servers. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest using AES-256 standards.

faqs.q: mdhub vs Freed: which is better for psychiatrists?
faqs.a: mdhub is purpose-built for behavioral health with CPT coding and psychiatric workflows. Freed is more generalist but offers transparent pricing ($39-119/mo) and faster self-signup. If you want psychiatry-specific features and can engage sales, mdhub. If you want to start today with known costs, Freed.
